title: Catalog
description: The root of `catalog.json`: every chassis, mech, vehicle, turret, component, terrain, biome, map, event, item collection and faction definition the game has loaded, keyed by id. It describes the game, not the career, so it only changes with the game's data.

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last written, in ISO 8601 with the local time's UTC offset.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last wrote the file.

sourceFingerprint.description: A hash of the game's data files the catalog was built from: of every one it reads, its id, file and last write time; the catalog is rebuilt when it differs from the game's current data.

chassisDefinitions.description: The chassis, keyed by chassis id.

mechDefinitions.description: The mechs, keyed by mech id.

vehicleDefinitions.description: The vehicles, keyed by vehicle id.

turretDefinitions.description: The turrets, keyed by turret id.

componentDefinitions.description: The components, grouped by type and keyed by component id.

terrainDefinitions.description: The terrains, keyed by design mask id.

biomeDefinitions.description: The biomes, keyed by the biome id the star systems and maps refer to.

mapDefinitions.description: The maps a star system's contracts can be fought on, keyed by map id.

eventDefinitions.description: The events, keyed by event id.

itemCollectionDefinitions.description: The item collections the stores draw their stock from and the rewards are drawn from, keyed by collection id; a star system's stores name theirs in `star-systems.json`.

factionDefinitions.description: The factions' allies and enemies, keyed by faction id.

ChassisDefinition.description: A chassis: the frame its mechs share, without anything a loadout decides.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name with the variant, as in the references to the chassis.

tonnage.description: The weight in tons; for a chassis, the most a mech of it may weigh.

initialTonnage.description: The bare chassis' tonnage, which a mech's tonnage starts from.

value.description: The C-Bill value of the chassis, which rules.json campaign.finances.sellShare and rules.json campaign.finances.scrapShare apply to when a stored chassis is sold or a mech, chassis or mech parts are scrapped.

maxJumpJets.description: The most jump jets a mech of the chassis can mount; 0 when it can't jump.

dissipation.description: The heat the chassis itself removes per round, on top of its heat sinks.

movement.description: The walk and sprint distances and the pathing, which no loadout changes.

melee.description: The damage of melee and jump attacks, before upgrades add to them.

stockMech.description: The mech the game treats as the chassis' stock loadout; `null` when its definition is missing.

locations.description: The body locations, from head to legs.

ChassisMovement.description: How the unit moves, with the distances in meters; a chassis' speed doesn't depend on its loadout.

walk.description: The movement of a walk, which each step uses up per meter by its terrain's move cost (TerrainDefinition.moveCost).

sprint.description: The movement of a sprint, which each step uses up per meter by its terrain's move cost (TerrainDefinition.moveCost) times its TerrainDefinition.sprintMultiplier.

pathingId.description: The game's pathing capabilities the unit moves with, which decide the slopes it can climb, as in combat-map.json pathingGroups.

ChassisMelee.description: The chassis' melee values, before upgrades add to them.

damage.description: The damage of a melee attack.

stabilityDamage.description: The stability damage of a melee attack.

deathFromAboveDamage.description: The damage of a jump attack onto a target.

deathFromAboveSelfDamage.description: The damage the mech takes from its own jump attack.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The definition's id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction).

ChassisLocationDefinition.description: A body location of a chassis: its limits and hardpoints.

maxArmor.description: The most armor the location can take.

slots.description: The component slots, which a loadout's components fill by their own slots.

LocationArmorOfNumber.description: A location's armor by side, in whatever a file measures armor in.

front.description: The front armor; outside the torso, the location's only armor.

rear.description: `null` outside the torso, which alone has rear armor.

Hardpoints.description: The number of weapon hardpoints of each kind.

MechDefinition.description: A mech: a loadout on a chassis, which a mech assembled from parts or bought comes with while rules.json campaign.salvage.assembledMechsComeEquipped is true. The frame is in chassisDefinitions.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name with the variant, as in the references to the mech.

value.description: The C-Bill value the game computes from the chassis, armor and components.

usedTonnage.description: The tonnage of the chassis, armor and components.

stats.description: The performance summary of the mech with this loadout.

isSalvageable.description: Whether defeating it can give its mech parts as salvage; the game's `BLACKLISTED` tag rules it out, e.g. for hero variants.

locations.description: The body locations, from head to legs.

MechStats.description: The performance summary of the mech lab and mech bay: the ratings of the stat bars and the numbers behind them. Only working components count.

ratings.description: The ratings of the stat bars.

movement.description: The walk, sprint and jump distances.

heat.description: The heat dissipated, generated and tolerated.

firepower.description: The damage of firing every weapon at once.

range.description: The weapons' maximum and average medium range.

durability.description: The armor and structure, and the damage taken from the mech's own jump attack.

melee.description: The damage of melee and jump attacks.

StatRatings.description: The stat bars, each rated from 0 against the game's stock mechs; a bar is full at 10, which a rating can exceed.

firepower.description: Rated from the weapons' damage and stability damage.

movement.description: Rated from the sprint distance and the number of jump jets.

range.description: Rated from the weapons' average medium range.

heatEfficiency.description: Rated from the heat dissipation against the heat of firing every weapon and jumping, and from bonuses to the shutdown heat.

durability.description: Rated from the armor, the structure and upgrades reducing stability damage taken.

melee.description: Rated from the melee attack's damage and stability damage.

walk.description: The chassis' walk distance, as in ChassisMovement.walk.

sprint.description: The chassis' sprint distance, as in ChassisMovement.sprint.

jump.description: The jump distance with the working jump jets and their bonuses; 0 without any.

HeatStats.description: The heat dissipated, generated and tolerated.

dissipation.description: The heat removed per round by the built-in and mounted heat sinks.

alphaStrike.description: The heat generated by firing every weapon at once.

averageJump.description: The heat generated by an average jump.

shutdown.description: The heat at which the mech shuts down.

FirepowerStats.description: The damage of firing every weapon at once.

damage.description: The damage of all the weapons' shots; COIL weapons count with three evasion pips, as the game's stats assume.

stabilityDamage.description: The stability damage of all the weapons' shots.

max.description: The longest maximum range of the weapons, in meters.

optimal.description: The weapons' average medium range, in meters.

DurabilityStats.description: The armor and structure, and the damage taken from the mech's own jump attack.

armor.description: The armor left on all locations.

structure.description: The structure left on all locations.

deathFromAboveSelfDamage.description: The damage the mech takes from its own jump attack.

MeleeStats.description: The damage of melee and jump attacks.

damage.description: The damage of a melee attack, the chassis' plus upgrades' bonuses.

stabilityDamage.description: The stability damage of a melee attack, the chassis' plus upgrades' bonuses.

deathFromAboveDamage.description: The damage of a jump attack onto a target.

MechLocationDefinition.description: A body location of a mech definition, with its armor and components.

components.description: The components mounted in the location, in the game's order.

LoadoutComponent.description: A component of a mech definition's loadout.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

isFixed.description: Whether the component is part of the chassis: every mech of the chassis has it, and it can't be removed.

ComponentReference.description: A component's definition, like DefinitionReference, with the type that tells which group of componentDefinitions holds it. Components compare by type first, then as every reference.

id.description: The component definition's id from the game's data files.

type.description: The game's component type, e.g. `Weapon` or `AmmunitionBox`, which names the component's group in componentDefinitions; never `NotSet`, `Special` or `MechPart`, which the game's enum also has.

ComponentType.description: The game's kind of component, which names the component's group in catalog.json componentDefinitions.

VehicleDefinition.description: A vehicle with its chassis' data: its armor and loadout are fixed, as it fights in combat.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name the combat HUD shows.

tonnage.description: The weight in tons; for a chassis, the most a mech of it may weigh.

movementType.description: How the vehicle moves, `Tracked` or `Wheeled`, which picks its row of every terrain's TerrainDefinition.moveCost.

movement.description: The walk and sprint distances and the pathing.

locations.description: The locations from front to rear, then the turret if the vehicle has one.

VehicleMovementType.description: How a vehicle moves, which picks its row of a terrain's move costs.

VehicleLocationDefinition.description: A location of a vehicle: its armor, structure and components.

armor.description: The armor in combat, after the game's vehicle multiplier; a vehicle has no rear armor.

structure.description: The internal structure in combat, after the game's vehicle multiplier.

components.description: The components mounted in the location, in the game's order, all fixed.

TurretDefinition.description: A turret with its chassis' data: a fixed emplacement with a single location.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name the combat HUD shows.

tonnage.description: The weight in tons; for a chassis, the most a mech of it may weigh.

firingArcDegrees.description: How far to either side of its facing it can fire, in degrees.

armor.description: The armor in combat, after the game's vehicle multiplier; a turret has no rear armor.

structure.description: The internal structure in combat, after the game's vehicle multiplier.

components.description: The components mounted, in the game's order, all fixed.

ComponentDefinitions.description: The catalog's component definitions, which every export file's references point to, grouped by ComponentReference.type and keyed by component id: a reference's `type` names its group, `Weapon` in `weapons`, `AmmunitionBox` in `ammunitionBoxes`, `HeatSink` in `heatSinks`, `JumpJet` in `jumpJets` and `Upgrade` in `upgrades`. A reference whose definition the game can't find has no entry; its id stands in for its name.

weapons.description: The components of type `Weapon`, keyed by component id, without the game's internal melee, jump attack and AI weapons, which no unit mounts.

ammunitionBoxes.description: The components of type `AmmunitionBox`, keyed by component id.

heatSinks.description: The components of type `HeatSink`, keyed by component id.

jumpJets.description: The components of type `JumpJet`, keyed by component id.

upgrades.description: The components of type `Upgrade`, e.g. actuators, cockpit mods and gyros, keyed by component id; they have only the common fields.

WeaponDefinition.description: A weapon: its damage, heat, ammunition and ranges.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name the mech lab shows, as in the references to the component.

slots.description: The slots the component takes up in the location it's mounted in.

value.description: The C-Bill value of the component.

effects.description: The statistics the component changes while mounted.

isSalvageable.description: Whether the component can come as salvage; the game's `BLACKLISTED` tag rules it out. Nothing else follows from it, e.g. about stores.

category.description: The hardpoint kind the weapon needs, e.g. "Ballistic" or "Support", which also keys rules.json combat.weaponCategories.

ammoCategory.description: The ammo the weapon fires, as AmmunitionBoxDefinition.ammoCategory names it; a weapon with internalAmmoCapacity fires its own ammo first and then any boxes of the category, which the catalog has none of; `null` when it needs no ammo.

internalAmmoCapacity.description: The shots a weapon that carries its own ammo, like a flamer, has per mission; `null` for every other weapon.

structureDamage.description: The damage of one shot that goes straight to the structure, on top of damage and whatever armor is left; a mech hit by it can take a critical hit with armor left.

stabilityDamage.description: The stability damage of one shot.

projectilesPerShot.description: The projectiles the attack's animation shows per shot; only the visuals use it, each shot hits or misses whole.

heatDamage.description: The heat the target takes per shot.

heatGenerated.description: The heat the mech takes per attack.

coil.description: How the COIL weapon gains from its mech's evasive pips, as rules.json combat.coil applies it; `null` for every other weapon.

ranges.description: The range brackets, which decide the to-hit modifier by the target's distance.

accuracyModifier.description: The weapon's own to-hit modifier, which the hit chance adds to the others; positive makes the attack harder, as in rules.json combat.toHit.

criticalChanceMultiplier.description: Multiplies the chance of the weapon's hits to cause a critical hit; 1 leaves it unchanged.

refireModifier.description: The to-hit modifier for firing again in the next round; positive makes the attack harder.

isIndirectFireCapable.description: Whether the weapon can fire at targets out of line of sight.

StatisticChange.description: A change an ability or a component makes to a statistic of the unit, its pilot or its components.

statistic.description: The statistic's name, as the game names it.

operation.description: How value changes the statistic, e.g. `Set`, `Int_Add`.

value.description: A boolean, integer or number, as the statistic's type requires. Changes to the initiative statistics (`BaseInitiative`, `PhaseModifier`, `PhaseModifierSelf`) are as the HUD numbers phases, so a positive change makes the unit act earlier.

appliesTo.description: The pilot or the components whose statistic changes; `null` for the unit's own.

duration.description: How long the change lasts; `null` when it lasts for the whole mission.

target.description: Whose statistic changes: the unit with the ability or component (`Creator`), the unit it targets (`SingleTarget`) or a group around it; always one the game acts on, where its data leaves it unset.

trigger.description: When the change is made, e.g. on the ability's activation, on a hit or always (`Passive`).

StatOperation.description: How a statistic change applies its value to the statistic.

EffectTargetCollection.description: The pilot or the components of the unit whose statistic a change applies to.

collection.description: The pilot, the weapons, the ammunition boxes, one random working weapon or the strongest working weapon.

filter.description: Which of the weapons or ammunition boxes; `null` for all of them, and always for the pilot, the random and the strongest weapon.

TargetCollection.description: Which of a unit's parts a statistic change applies to: its pilot or a group of its components.

ComponentFilter.description: The one property the game filters the components by; the game's data can name several, of which only the first in ComponentFilterKind's order counts. Each kind has a record with its value's type.

ComponentFilterKind.description: The property of a component an effect's filter compares, in the order the game checks them.

AmmoCategoryFilter.description: A filter on the ammunition boxes' category.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The ammunition category the ammunition boxes must have, as the catalog's ammunition boxes name theirs.

WeaponCategoryFilter.description: A filter on the weapons' category.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The weapon category the weapons must have, as the catalog's weapons name theirs.

WeaponSubTypeFilter.description: A filter on the weapons' sub type.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The weapon sub type the weapons must have, e.g. `Melee` or `DFA`.

WeaponSubType.description: A weapon's sub type, e.g. a weapon model or a melee attack.

WeaponTypeFilter.description: A filter on the weapons' type.

kind.description: Which property of the components the filter compares, deciding the type of its value.

value.description: The weapon type the weapons must have, e.g. `LRM` or `SRM`.

WeaponType.description: A weapon's type, e.g. a weapon family or melee.

EffectDuration.description: How long a statistic change lasts.

count.description: How many activations, rounds, movements or phases, by its unit, the change lasts; at least 1.

EffectDurationUnit.description: What an effect's duration counts, as `Effect` picks its `ETimer`. `activations`: The activations of the unit that made the effect. `targetActivations`: The activations of the unit the effect is on.

EffectTargetType.description: Whose statistic a change applies to, relative to the unit with the ability or component.

EffectTriggerType.description: When the game makes a statistic change.

CoilWeapon.description: How a COIL weapon gains from its mech's evasive pips.

evasiveExponent.description: The power of the evasive pips that multiplies the damage of one shot; 0 leaves the damage at its base.

heatDivisor.description: The heat the mech takes per attack is the damage of one shot as fired, after the evasive pips' increase and rules.json combat.damage.globalMultiplier, divided by this; `null` when WeaponDefinition.heatGenerated applies instead.

WeaponRanges.description: The range brackets in meters, each with its to-hit modifier in rules.json combat.toHit.rangeBands.

min.description: The minimum range; closer, the weapon still fires, with rules.json combat.toHit.rangeBands.withinMinimumRange.

short.description: The end of the short bracket, from min, where rules.json combat.toHit.rangeBands.short applies.

medium.description: The end of the medium bracket, from short, where rules.json combat.toHit.rangeBands.medium applies.

long.description: The end of the long bracket, from medium, where rules.json combat.toHit.rangeBands.long applies.

max.description: The end of the maximum bracket, from long, where rules.json combat.toHit.rangeBands.maximum applies; the weapon can't fire beyond it.

AmmunitionBoxDefinition.description: An ammunition box, which feeds the weapons of its ammunition category.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name the mech lab shows, as in the references to the component.

slots.description: The slots the component takes up in the location it's mounted in.

value.description: The C-Bill value of the component.

effects.description: The statistics the component changes while mounted.

isSalvageable.description: Whether the component can come as salvage; the game's `BLACKLISTED` tag rules it out. Nothing else follows from it, e.g. about stores.

ammoCategory.description: The weapons the ammo fits, e.g. "AC/5".

capacity.description: The shots in the box; it is full at the start of every mission.

HeatSinkDefinition.description: A heat sink, mounted on top of the engine's built-in ones.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name the mech lab shows, as in the references to the component.

slots.description: The slots the component takes up in the location it's mounted in.

value.description: The C-Bill value of the component.

effects.description: The statistics the component changes while mounted.

isSalvageable.description: Whether the component can come as salvage; the game's `BLACKLISTED` tag rules it out. Nothing else follows from it, e.g. about stores.

dissipation.description: The heat the heat sink removes per round.

JumpJetDefinition.description: A jump jet, which only mechs whose chassis tonnage is within its range can mount.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name the mech lab shows, as in the references to the component.

slots.description: The slots the component takes up in the location it's mounted in.

value.description: The C-Bill value of the component.

effects.description: The statistics the component changes while mounted.

isSalvageable.description: Whether the component can come as salvage; the game's `BLACKLISTED` tag rules it out. Nothing else follows from it, e.g. about stores.

minTonnage.description: The lowest chassis tonnage that can mount the jump jet, inclusive.

maxTonnage.description: The highest chassis tonnage that can mount the jump jet, inclusive.

ComponentDefinition.description: The fields every component definition has; the definitions of types with stats of their own derive from it. Upgrades have no others.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The name the mech lab shows, as in the references to the component.

slots.description: The slots the component takes up in the location it's mounted in.

value.description: The C-Bill value of the component.

effects.description: The statistics the component changes while mounted.

isSalvageable.description: Whether the component can come as salvage; the game's `BLACKLISTED` tag rules it out. Nothing else follows from it, e.g. about stores.

TerrainDefinition.description: A terrain's effects on the units in it: forest, water, rough ground, roads and the like. A cell has one terrain at most, so the effects never stack; the map's biome applies on top (see BiomeDefinition).

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: As the combat HUD shows it.

moveCost.description: What a step into the terrain costs of the unit's movement, per meter of the step; `null` where the unit can't enter. Open ground has no terrain and costs 1.05 for every unit in the game's data.

sprintMultiplier.description: Multiplies the move cost when sprinting; `null` where the terrain is impassable.

visibilityMultiplier.description: Multiplies the spotting distance a sight line uses up while it passes through the terrain below visibilityHeight.

sensorRangeMultiplier.description: Multiplies the sensor range of a unit in the terrain.

signatureMultiplier.description: Multiplies the signature of a unit in the terrain.

toHitAgainstRanged.description: The to-hit modifier of ranged attacks against a mech or vehicle in the terrain, not a turret; positive makes the attack harder, as in rules.json combat.toHit.

toHitAgainstMelee.description: The to-hit modifier of melee attacks against a mech or vehicle in the terrain, not a turret; positive makes the attack harder.

toHitFromRanged.description: The to-hit modifier of ranged attacks by a unit in the terrain; positive makes the attack harder.

grantsGuarded.description: Whether a unit in the terrain has a guard level from cover.

heatSinkMultiplier.description: Multiplies the heat sink capacity of a mech in the terrain.

heatPerRound.description: Added to a mech's heat at the end of its activation in the terrain.

damageDealt.description: Multiplies the damage of a unit firing from the terrain, by weapon category.

damageTaken.description: Multiplies the damage a unit in the terrain takes, by weapon category; buildings take none.

stickyEffects.description: What a unit gets when it enters, crosses or starts its activation in the terrain.

TerrainMoveCosts.description: By the unit: a mech, a tracked vehicle or a wheeled vehicle, and its weight class.

mech.description: For mechs, by their weight class; `null` where they can't enter.

tracked.description: For tracked vehicles, by their weight class; `null` where they can't enter.

wheeled.description: For wheeled vehicles, by their weight class; `null` where they can't enter.

ByWeightClassOfNullableNumber.description: A value per weight class of the unit it applies to.

DamageMultipliers.description: The multiplier for every attack and the weapon category's both apply; melee and jump attacks get only the one for every attack.

byWeaponCategory.description: The weapon category's multiplier keyed by every WeaponDefinition.category the game knows, as rules.json combat.weaponCategories are; 1 for a category without one, such as `Melee`.

BiomeDefinition.description: A biome's effects on every unit on its maps, on top of the terrain's (see TerrainDefinition); the game reads nothing else from a biome.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: As in the references to the biome.

heatSinkMultiplier.description: Multiplies every mech's heat sink capacity.

heatPerRound.description: Added to every mech's heat at the end of its activation.

damageDealt.description: Multiplies every unit's weapon damage, by weapon category.

MapDefinition.description: A combat map some star system's contracts can be fought on, and the terrain it is made of. The contract generator draws a star system's map among the maps `star-systems.json` lists for the system, by weight.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

biome.description: The map's biome, as the star systems refer to it.

tags.description: The map tags the star systems' required and excluded map tags select the map by.

weight.description: The contract generator's draw weight among a star system's maps.

terrainCoverage.description: Each terrain's share of the map's playable cells, keyed by terrain id, plus `none` for the cells with no terrain (bare biome). Cells are all the same size, so a share is an area share; the shares sum to 1.

EventDefinition.description: An event the game can show between missions: when it can come, and the options it offers.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: The event's title as plain text. Placeholders in braces stand for what the game picks, by its prefix: `TGT_MW` the event's pilot, `SCN_MW` and `TRT_MW` the second and third pilot, `COMMANDER` the commander, `SCN_UNIT` the mech and `TGT_SYSTEM` the current star system; after the dot what of it is shown, e.g. `{TGT_MW.Callsign}`, the pronoun `{TGT_MW.Subj}` or `{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}`. A switch on a pilot's gender is resolved to its default wording.

scope.description: What the event is about: the company, or a pilot it picks among those meeting requirements and without an event timeout.

weight.description: The event's draw weight among the events that can come.

isOneTime.description: Whether the event comes at most once per career.

canBeDrawn.description: Whether the daily event roll can draw the event; when false, it comes only when another event's result schedules it.

requirements.description: What the event's company or pilot (scope) must meet; `null` when nothing.

additionalRequirements.description: What the other scopes must meet, all of them.

additionalTargets.description: The other pilots or the mech the event involves, each one the game finds meeting its requirements; without one, the event can't come.

options.description: The options the event offers, in the order it shows them.

EventScope.description: Who or what an event, a requirement or a result is about: the company, a pilot, a mech or the star system.

EventRequirement.description: What one scope's tags and statistics must be for an event to come, an option to be open or a result to apply.

scope.description: Whose tags and statistics are checked: the company's or a pilot's, the commander included (both in `game-state.json`), or the current star system's (in `star-systems.json`).

requiredTags.description: The tags that must all be present.

excludedTags.description: The tags none of which may be present.

comparisons.description: The statistic values that must all hold, apart from the stored components' counts in componentComparisons.

componentComparisons.description: The stored components' counts that must all hold.

StatisticComparison.description: A comparison a statistic of the scope must pass.

statistic.description: The statistic's name, as the game names it; a statistic the scope doesn't have counts as 0.

operator.description: How the statistic's value compares to value.

value.description: The value the statistic is compared to.

Operator.description: How a statistic's value compares to the required value.

ComponentComparison.description: A comparison of the company's working copies of a component in storage, as game-state.json storage.components[].count has them; a component not in storage counts as 0.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

operator.description: How the count compares to value.

value.description: The count it is compared to.

EventTarget.description: Another pilot or a mech the event involves, besides its own company or pilot.

scope.description: The second pilot, the third pilot or a mech in the mech bay.

requirements.description: What the pilot or mech must meet; `null` when any will do.

EventOption.description: An option the event offers; every option is shown, and one whose requirements aren't met can't be picked.

id.description: The option's id from the game's data files, e.g. `outcome_1`: the game names options so, not the outcomes.

name.description: The option's text, with placeholders as in EventDefinition.name.

requirements.description: What must be met to pick the option, all of them.

outcomes.description: What picking the option can lead to; the game draws one by weight.

EventOutcome.description: One of the outcomes an option can lead to, drawn by weight.

weight.description: The outcome's draw weight among the option's outcomes.

results.description: The changes the outcome makes, in order.

EventResult.description: One change an outcome makes to one scope.

scope.description: Whose tags and statistics change, or whom the actions concern.

requirements.description: What must be met for the result to apply; `null` when it always applies.

statisticChanges.description: The statistics changed, apart from the stored components' counts in componentChanges; a boolean statistic's value as 1 or 0, as the requirements compare it.

componentChanges.description: The components added to or taken from the company's storage.

durationDays.description: How many days the tag, statistic and component changes last before the game reverts them; `null` when they are permanent.

actions.description: What else the result does, e.g. kill or dismiss the pilot.

CareerStatisticChange.description: A change the career makes to a statistic of the company or a pilot, e.g. by a ship upgrade or an event. Simpler than a combat statistic change on purpose: the career only adds to a statistic or sets it.

statistic.description: The game's name of the statistic, e.g. "MechTechSkill".

value.description: The amount added to the statistic, or the value it is set to when isSet.

isSet.description: Whether the change sets the statistic to value instead of adding it.

ComponentChange.description: A change to how many copies of a component the company keeps in storage.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

count.description: The working copies added; negative for copies taken.

ResultAction.description: What else a result does, about the event's pilot or the company; each value of type has a record with the field it needs.

ActionType.description: What an event result's action does.

AddFlashpointAction.description: An action that makes a flashpoint available.

flashpoint.description: The flashpoint's id in the game's data.

AddPilotForHireAction.description: An action that adds a pilot to the current star system's hiring hall.

PilotReference.description: A pilot: their id, full name without callsign, and callsign.

name.description: The pilot's full name without callsign.

callsign.description: The pilot's callsign, which isn't part of name.

ChangeInjuriesAction.description: An action that adds injuries to or removes them from the event's pilot.

injuries.description: How many injuries the action adds or removes.

PilotOnlyAction.description: An action that needs only the event's pilot and no value: killing, dismissing or healing them, or adding or removing one injury.

RenamePilotAction.description: An action that renames the event's pilot.

callsign.description: The pilot's new callsign, which also becomes their name.

RewardAction.description: An action that rewards the company with a draw from an item collection.

itemCollection.description: The collection drawn from, keyed as in itemCollectionDefinitions.

SidelinePilotAction.description: An action that sidelines the event's pilot for a while.

days.description: How many days the pilot is sidelined for.

ForcedEvent.description: An event a result schedules: from the daily roll minDaysWait on, each roll brings it with chancePercent, and roll maxDaysWait always does.

scope.description: What the scheduled event is about.

minDaysWait.description: The first daily roll, counted from the next, that can bring the event.

maxDaysWait.description: The daily roll, counted from the next, that brings the event for sure.

chancePercent.description: The chance per daily roll, from 0 to 100.

keepsPilot.description: Whether the scheduled event is about the same pilot as the result.

ItemCollectionDefinition.description: An item collection: a weighted list the stores and the rewards draw their items from. A draw picks one entry by weight; a collection drawn in full yields every entry once, as a store's own collections are.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

components.description: The components a draw can yield.

mechs.description: The whole mechs a draw can yield.

mechParts.description: The mech parts a draw can yield.

collections.description: The collections a draw can yield, drawn in turn.

emptyWeight.description: The draw weight of the collection's empty entries, which use up a draw and yield nothing; 0 where it has none.

ComponentCollectionEntry.description: A component a draw from the collection can yield.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

count.description: The copies a draw yields; `null`: unlimited.

weight.description: The entry's draw weight among the collection's entries.

MechCollectionEntry.description: A whole mech a draw from the collection can yield.

count.description: The copies a draw yields; `null`: unlimited.

weight.description: The entry's draw weight among the collection's entries.

MechPartsCollectionEntry.description: Mech parts a draw from the collection can yield.

mech.description: The mech the parts assemble into, described in mechDefinitions.

count.description: The copies a draw yields; `null`: unlimited.

weight.description: The entry's draw weight among the collection's entries.

NestedCollectionEntry.description: Another collection a draw from the collection can yield, which is then drawn from in turn.

collection.description: The collection drawn from, by its id in itemCollectionDefinitions.

draws.description: The draws from the collection, each by weight and with the same entry possible again; `null`: every entry once.

weight.description: The entry's draw weight among the collection's entries.

FactionDefinition.description: A faction's relations to the other factions, which decide whom it hires the company against. Some faction references have no entry, such as `Player1sMercUnit` and `INVALID_UNSET`.

id.description: The id from the game's data files, which the entry is keyed by and the references to it use.

name.description: As in the references to the faction; not unique, since several ids can share a name.

allies.description: The factions allied with it, sorted by name; on its contracts, one of them not allied with the other side may fight alongside it. The faction's own list: an ally needn't list it back.

enemies.description: The factions hostile to it, sorted by name: those it can hire the company against where a star system lists them as targets; while the company is allied with it, the company's reputation entries mark them as enemies. The faction's own list: an enemy needn't list it back.
